blocks.text: October marks the 25th anniversary of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s public service, which began on Oct. 7, 2001, when he became chief minister of Gujarat, and culminated in his elevation as prime minister of India on May 13, 2014. For India, this period represents stability in national politics, coupled with continuity in operationalizing the foundations Modi laid during his first year in office. This year not only commemorates Modi’s 25 years of public service but also marks his tenure as India’s longest-serving elected prime minister.
